job.job_description:
Description

Design and build the APIs, data pipelines, and agentic workflows behind our AI-native products. Youll write production-grade services in Node.js and orchestrate LLMs, RAG, and multi-step agents. We value strong system design and a keen eye for detail, and we build day to day with AI coding agents.
Responsibilities
Build and maintain the backend services, APIs, and data pipelines that power our AI-native products.
Ship agentic workflows to production - orchestrating LLMs, retrieval (RAG), and multi-step agents.
Own reliability and performance: monitoring, observability, and scaling as usage grows.
Partner with product engineers and designers to move features from spec to release.
Build day to day with AI coding agents such as Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code to ship faster.
Qualifications
Several years of backend engineering with Node.js, with strong system-design and architecture fundamentals.
Solid grounding in API design, data modelling, and event-driven or asynchronous systems.
Working knowledge of LLMs, vector databases, RAG, or agent frameworks - or the drive to master them quickly.
Fluency in an AI-assisted development workflow - comfortable pairing with coding agents like Cursor, Codex, and Claude Code and directing them well.
Experience with cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and running services in production.
Job Benefits
Fully remote across India - work from wherever youre most productive, with no commute and no relocation. Weve been remote-first for years, so the tools and habits that make distributed work smooth are already in place.
Flexible timings - we care about outcomes, not hours logged. Structure your day around when you do your best work and the commitments in your life outside it, and coordinate with your team on the overlap that matters.
Long weekend leaves - regular long weekends built into the calendar give you real time to step away, recharge and come back sharp, on top of your standard leave.
Opportunity to work alongside senior engineers and applied-AI researchers on production agentic systems that real users depend on, and to grow quickly through direct mentorship and genuinely hard distributed-systems problems.
